mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_user_report_period_agg ( market_site_id, market_team_id, marketer_id, period_type, period_start, period_end, register_user_count, login_user_count, first_recharge_user_count, first_recharge_amt, recharge_user_count, recharge_times, recharge_amt, cash_out_user_count,cash_out_times, cash_out_amt, order_user_count, order_amt, order_result_amt, agg_version,update_time ) SELECT u.market_site_id, u.market_team_id, u.marketer_id, #{periodType} AS p_type, CURDATE(), CURDATE(), COUNT( DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.register_status = 1 THEN t.user_id END ), COUNT( DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.login_times > 0 THEN t.user_id END ), COUNT( DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.first_recharge_status = 1 THEN t.user_id END ), IFNULL( SUM( t.first_recharge_amt ), 0 ), COUNT( DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.recharge_times > 0 THEN t.user_id END ), IFNULL( SUM( t.recharge_times ), 0 ), IFNULL( SUM( t.recharge_amt ), 0 ), COUNT( DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.user_cash_out_times > 0 || t.agent_cash_out_times > 0 THEN t.user_id END ), IFNULL( SUM( t.user_cash_out_times + t.agent_cash_out_times ), 0 ), IFNULL( SUM( t.user_cash_out_amt + t.agent_cash_out_amt ), 0 ), COUNT( DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.placeorder_times > 0 THEN t.user_id END ), IFNULL( SUM( t.order_amt ), 0 ), IFNULL( SUM( t.order_result_amt ), 0 ), 1, NOW() FROM s_user_report t INNER JOIN s_user u ON u.id = t.user_id AND u.user_type != 1 WHERE t.report_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY u.market_site_id,u.market_team_id,u.marketer_id ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE register_user_count = VALUES(register_user_count), login_user_count = VALUES(login_user_count), first_recharge_user_count = VALUES(first_recharge_user_count), first_recharge_amt = VALUES(first_recharge_amt), recharge_user_count = VALUES(recharge_user_count), recharge_times = VALUES(recharge_times), recharge_amt = VALUES(recharge_amt), cash_out_times = VALUES(cash_out_times), cash_out_amt = VALUES(cash_out_amt), order_user_count = VALUES(order_user_count), order_amt = VALUES(order_amt), order_result_amt = VALUES(order_result_amt), agg_version = agg_version + 1, update_time = NOW();
